s:Codelist.c:Name: Seasonal adjustment

s:Codelist.c:Description: This code list referes to seasonal adjustment. It is a statistical method for removing the effects of recurring seasonal influences which have been observed in the past from an economic time series, thus showing non-seasonal trends more clearly.

s:Codelist.c:Name: National accounts indicator (ESA 2010)
Indicateur des comptes nationaux (SEC 2010)
s:Codelist.c:Description: This code list defines different type of national accounts indicators. National accounts are a coherent and consistent set of macroeconomic indicators providing information to analyse the structure of economies and their development over time. The methodology is defined by the European System of National and Regional Accounts 2010, ESA 2010.
